Codebase review 2026-10-05 on main 3b2211a7bba7fb5699bd7fef3f9bb078bb6866a8. Classification: unimplemented.

InputAdapterFxSuite contains its own firing flag and foreign-event filter, which explains local stability but is exactly the local workaround the ticket says to retire. The shared FxStage/StudioRobot suite-wide gate, opt-out mechanism, receipt counts, routed direct mouse firing, and popup/context-menu documentation were not established. Headless default reduces interference but does not satisfy the visible Mac-glass suite-wide contract. Move the mechanism into the harness and verify it across affected FX suites.

Evidence:
- studio/desktop/src/test/scala/eyes4s/studio/desktop/trial/InputAdapterFxSuite.scala:134
- studio/desktop/src/test/scala/eyes4s/studio/desktop/trial/InputAdapterFxSuite.scala:193
- docs/studio/IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md:884

Remaining / next action: Implement harness-level global gate/receipts/opt-out, route direct events, and delete the local adapter filter.

Disposition: Keep open.
